title: Semester Survival 3D: Playable Version
description: A playable Three.js 3D campus runner preview featuring Jay, mobile and keyboard controls, campus traffic, obstacles, pickups, upgrades, and run progression. Campaign endings and final-game polish are still in development.

maker.name: Joseph Ombati
maker.bio: Creator and Game Director of Semester Survival.

touch.swipe: Left/right to change lanes, up to jump, down to slide

technical.rendering: Three.js WebGL renderer with original runner simulation
